tolerance_contract: den_i = unit-specific absolute tolerance + rtol * frozen max(abs(initial_i), unit-specific numerical floor)
other_units: explicit NUMERICAL_UNIT_SCALES registry in retina_sim/background.py; unregistered state units return INCONCLUSIVE
criteria: window_seconds * pure one-step transition defect / native period
consecutive complete windows after explicit minimum duration
stochastic_criterion: graded states independent of generated spikes checked deterministically; seeded spike histories advance and burn in separately; stationarity statistics require an explicitly supplied statistical acceptance policy
monitoring_scope: accepted event endpoints plus explicit numerical monitoring grid; sub-grid extrema are not a mathematical certificate
budget_policy: simulation cap, independent wall-time and observation budgets; incomplete windows cannot pass; last valid state retained
claim: numerical preparation policy; no universal biological adaptation duration or physiological validation
